items.title: Digital Extremes Amps Up the Voltage of Warframe’s Free Rewards Track with Nightwave Mix: Amir’s Shockwave , Inviting Players to Hack the Airwaves for All-New Customizations and More
items.summary: 'Nightwave Mix: Amir’s Shockwave' gets the blood pumping as free rewards track gets even more exciting.
items.content:
LONDON, Ontario – August 12, 2026 – Hack the airwaves in Warframe with Nightwave Mix: Amir’s Shockwave on all platforms for free today. Crank the volume with a limited-time, themed takeover of Warframe’s free rewards track for slick rewards and a wild time. Hear a glitch in the signal? Harmonize with new permanent feature additions like Fables & Frontiers: Running Late , a new mini-narrative text adventure with The Hex of Warframe: 1999 , a highly-requested new On-lyne song, “Running Late,” the Baruuk Shaoshi Warframe Skin, and fresh community-designed TennoGen cosmetics.

Feel the electric shock of the new hit On-lyne track, “Running Late”

Tune in to Amir’s hacked Nightwave Mix broadcast, Amir’s Shockwave , for a special Warframe: 1999 -themed edition with new voice lines from Kevin Afghani ( Super Mario Bros. Wonder ). Throughout this limited-time event, earn free rewards through gameplay like the Kaneshell Atomicycle Regalia Operator/Drifter outfit, Globakk Syndana backpiece, and more.

Vibe with a rebel radio DJ broadcast as Warframe's take on a free rewards track. Complete daily, temporary weekly, and permanent weekly gameplay objectives to progress through reward tiers packed with useful gear and exclusive cosmetics that are only available for a limited window until the next edition of Nightwave begins. Access Nightwave progress through the Orbiter Navigation console or radio scanner to track progress, browse or claim rewards, and see what challenges await.

Return to 1999 and reunite with The Hex crew for a game of Fables & Frontiers . Following completion of The Hex Quest and achieving Rank 5 with The Hex Syndicate and a “Close” relationship level with Amir, head to the POM-2 terminal in the Orbiter for a tabletop RPG-inspired text adventure, Fables & Frontiers: Running Late . Prepare to be whisked away by the imagination of newfound Fablemaster, Amir Beckett ( Volt ), over a six-day journey full of magic dice and formidable foes.

Explore the expanded Höllvania Mall social hub and discover Amir’s new game room, The Dominion of Höllvandeim. Ring the bell to summon Amir away from setting high scores at the arcade, and swap out his usual wares for new and returning cosmetic rewards. Fables & Frontiers: Running Late will remain a permanent fixture in Warframe once Nightwave Mix: Amir’s Shockwave concludes.

Get ready for three new in-game music tracks available today. First, Warframe’s hottest boyband, On-lyne , is back just in time for their long-awaited new track, “Running Late.” Keep a spare pair of batteries ready for the CD player, with two other new Fables & Frontiers tracks now available today on all major music streaming platforms, including Spotify , Apple Music , YouTube Music , Amazon Music , Bandcamp , and more.

Alter the airwaves of fashion with several new cosmetics available from the Warframe Market, like the Shaoshi Collection of cosmetics for Baruuk , the reluctant warrior. Six new community-created cosmetics from Digital Extremes’ player-design program, TennoGen , are also available today, including the Kullervo Ascophilia Warframe Skin by Erneix, Harrow Profitas Warframe Skin by Malaya, Jadie, and Noxxr, Haemadys Operator Mask by Vhynnz, Oraxia Agamva Warframe Helmet by Led2012, Centurio Signa headpiece by Lubox, and Acheta Signa headpiece by blazingcobalt and Ritens.

For more information about Warframe, please visit the official website , the official wiki , or follow our Bluesky , Twitter/X , Instagram , YouTube , Twitch , and TikTok accounts.

Warframe ® has evolved the looter-shooter genre since its debut on PC in 2013, becoming a multi-generational game with more than 90 million registered players across multiple console and mobile platforms. In this free sci-fi epic, players join an ancient class of warriors, the Tenno, and fight their way through an ever-expanding universe of more than 18 planets and 60 Warframes, with four open worlds to discover. With unrivaled customization, an intriguing narrative, and one of the most welcoming communities in gaming, players can define their playstyle and become an unstoppable force with a squad. Warframe’s success has led to the creation of TennoCon, where thousands of fans descend upon the heart of Digital Extremes’ creative operations in London, Ontario, annually to discover the future of the game. For more information about Warframe, please visit: www.warframe.com .

Digital Extremes ranks as one of the world's top video game development studios. Originating 30 years ago with the co-creation of Epic Games' multi-million unit selling Unreal ® franchise, including Unreal and Unreal Tournament, Digital Extremes went on to develop Dark Sector ® , BioShock ® for the PlayStation ® 3, the BioShock 2 multiplayer campaign, and The Darkness ® II. The studio develops its games using its proprietary Evolution Engine and reached critical and commercial success with the free-to-play action game Warframe ® , supporting a global community of 90+ million registered players across all major core gaming platforms. Digital Extremes is currently developing its new IP – Soulframe ® – with additional updates coming soon. For more information about Digital Extremes, visit www.digitalextremes.com .

items.title: Roll for initiative: Warframe’s Amir’s Shockwave event is live today with Fables & Frontiers
Amir’s Shockwave is Live!
items.summary: Amplify your Arsenal with all-new Rewards like the Globakk Syandana, Kaneshell Atomicycle Regalia, Teisatz Oculus and more. Prepare for a shift in the balance of power — as Amir’s Shockwave is now live! The hex hacker’s electric personality
items.content:
Amplify your Arsenal with all-new Rewards like the Globakk Syandana, Kaneshell Atomicycle Regalia, Teisatz Oculus and more. Prepare for a shift in the balance of power — as Amir’s Shockwave is now live! The hex hacker’s electric personality is amplifying this Nightwave Mix with all-new Rewards like the 1999-themed Globakk Syandana, Kaneshell Atomicycle Regalia, Teisatz Oculus and oh-so much more.

Fables & Frontiers: Running Late

Entirely separate from this new series of Nightwave Mix Rewards, there’s also the brand-new six-day KIM mini narrative adventure in the form of Fables & Frontiers: Running Late! Allow the mischievous technophile Amir to guide you through this bite-sized take on the Fables & Frontiers tabletop game from the world of Warframe: 1999. To unlock Fables & Frontiers: Running Late, you must complete The Hex Quest’s finale and reach Rank 5 with The Hex Syndicate and a KIM Chemistry of “Close” (Rank 5) with Amir himself. Earn several all-new Rewards from Fables & Frontiers: Running Late, including the Atomicycle Key Sugatra, Fables & Frontiers Glyphs for each member of The Hex, several returning items from Nora's Mix Vol. 8 and much more! All of these can be redeemed from Amir by ringing the bell in a new area of The Höllvania Central Mall in exchange for Hex Standing. Please Note: Fables & Frontiers: Running Late is a permanent addition to the KIM System that you can access anytime by meeting the correct prerequisites and is not tied to Nightwave Mix: Amir’s Shockwave.

What is Nightwave?

Experiencing this facet of Warframe for the first time? Nightwave is a pirate radio broadcast hosted by Nora Night (or, in this case, Amir of The Hex), focused on the latest stories in the Origin System. Nightwave is also a series of Daily, Weekly and now Acts. All of which offer new and useful (and often entirely unique) Rewards! Nightwave is available via the Base of Operations’ Navigation console, through the Orbiter’s radio scanner (located on the left side of your Orbiter’s bridge), or via the Pause Menu UI. In the Nightwave menu, you’ll see your progress through the current mix, your current Reward Tiers, as well as a rotating set of Daily, Weekly, Elite Weekly and Permanent Weekly Acts. Stick with Nightwave each day and get some fantastic Customizations!

items.title: "The world's becoming so bleak": How Soulframe hopes to escape Warframe's shadow, with a little insight from Elden Ring
items.summary: A chat with Digital Extremes about how Soulframe hopes to escape Warframe's long, prosperous shadow.
items.content:
A chat with Digital Extremes about hope, skill and overkill

Image credit: Digital Extremes Feature by Edwin Evans-Thirlwell News Editor Published on Aug. 12, 2026, 3:17 p.m. 10 comments Follow Soulframe Fantasy RPG Soulframe 's great advantage and possible curse is that it's from the studio behind Warframe , the free-to-play sci-fi bonanza that has kept chugging away since 2013, amid increasingly rocky prospects for live service games in general.

Warframe continues to pull a crowd, as was evident at this year's somewhat dystopian Tennocon expo, in which there was a whole auditorium set aside to house the queue for a bunch of T-shirt stands. That popularity gives Soulframe leeway to experiment and screw up, but it also creates temptation for developers Digital Extremes (who are owned by Tencent) to stick with what they know. Still, Warframe won't be a hit forever. As such, Soulframe's creators are trying to walk the line between lifting ideas from Warframe, and luring a new following with combat mechanics that take inspiration from Elden Ring .

According to Soulframe design director and former Warframe design director Scott McGregor, one thematic departure is that Soulframe's universe is relatively hopeful, however troubled. It takes place on a rustic medieval planet that is being colonised by a bunch of evil spacefaring moblins called the Ode, who are governed by a hypnotic Spellsong. As an Envoy empowered by a pact with ancient Fey spirits, you must stomp the Ode's raucous tinhat enforcers and free the moist-eyed critters they've imprisoned or corrupted. All of which reflects a conviction that the real world is going to hell.

"The world's becoming so bleak, and so hard to deal with, and everything seems to be getting so depressing," says McGregor. "And so when we were starting to work on Soulframe, it was looking for something that was maybe a little bit more inspirational, had a little bit more redemption to it than just, you know, more dark and evil.

"Those things exist in the game because you need to show the contrast and the evolution from that point, but for us as a team, it's looking for a happier place and a happier world," he continues. "And I think everyone feels that way right now. Like, the world doesn't feel like it's in a good spot, with the environment, with the political climate and all that sort of thing, so I think looking for an inspirational story or redemption arc is a big part of Soulframe."

Within that fuzzy objective of kindling optimism, the developers are also trying to peel themselves away from the sheer overkill of Warframe's combat. Soulframe has a bunch of projectile weaponry and ranged magic, but it hinges on methodical melee duels. It also doesn't have Warframe's absurd parkour system, which sees the most experienced players blinking through layouts in search of the choicest crafting materials.

"I would say we're still trying to sell that power fantasy to the player, but at a different pace and a different scale," McGregor continues. "Maybe you're a little bit more cosy, a little less bombastic. A lot of our review meetings, the stuff we talk about - we are trying to be very conscious about how explosive the screen is, and you know, how many times certain effects are applied to all of the enemies, or the number that you're engaging with at a single time, in a single fight. Making sure that it doesn't feel overwhelming for a single player, or a player who wants to play a little bit slower."

"I think what's interesting about working on this game from the design perspective is there's a higher skill barrier," he goes on. "Because it is a melee combat game, and there are some more timing-based aspects. You can get good at the game, even at a low level with bad gear and bad weapons. You could actually play at a pretty high level, if you have the mechanical skill… without necessarily having the gear."

McGregor draws a parallel with From Software's work. "You watch some of those Elden Ring players, where they go in there with a diaper on and the worst sword in the game, and they take on the best boss and you're, like, wow," he says. "Having it so that skill levels still matter, I think, is important as well. Warframe has a bit of that, but there's so much AOE room clearing - I'm gonna kill, like, 300 AIs with one button press."

Going by what I've played myself, I'm wary of Elden Ring parallels. Soulframe's melee combat isn't nearly as intricate or testing. Its open world is a sleepy golden expanse of forest glades and Ode camps in which you don't have to think too hard about terrain tactics, though there are some pleasantly enveloping dungeons beneath. Still, it's definitely more stately and precise than its older sister. It's a game of evasive rolls and parries in which you pay less attention to your stats. "It's definitely something that we're consciously always trying to manage," McGregor says, "and make sure that we don't go down that slope into Warframe land, because we definitely do want that contrast."

Like Warframe, Soulframe will live in 'eternal beta'. At the time of writing, the game has entered its 15th "prelude", these being the developer's Wordsworthian equivalents for early access updates. (Soulframe's writing in general is bardish to the point that I sometimes want to throw rotten eggs and tomatoes at it, like a drunken theatre goer in the 1500s). Digital Extremes are slowly adding stories, gear and areas while monitoring player feedback. After 13 years of Warfromage, the devs have learned a thing or two about keeping players glued to a work-in-progress, but they aren't, apparently, just reapplying the same lessons.

"I would say that there are some similarities, but the majority of the path that we're taking is actually quite different from the path we took with Warframe," says Sheldon Carter, studio president. "At least right now, that's what it feels like. One of the cool things, or also sometimes the chaotic things about live service is you're kind of driving the train while you're laying the tracks down." One rule of thumb is not to reveal things too early. Carter gives the example of Warframe's Duviri Paradox update, which was announced in 2019 and belatedly released in 2023. "We had to keep delaying it, because we didn't leave slack for getting punched in the face," Carter summarises, "and we got punched in the face on a few things between."

The major difference with Soulframe is that where early updates for Warframe were more about keeping the lights on, the new game has always been a live service project with a plan for years of significant changes. "I'll say the ambition is bigger on Soulframe from update to update, early in the game than we were on Warframe," McGregor recalls. "Warframe was a lot of really small, quick updates to add more life to the game, to add more content to the game. Soulframe updates so far have been bigger swings. We definitely feel like we've got to get back to those quicker ones, but there's an overall idea of what the story is, what the progression is going to be."

items.title: When does Nightwave: Amir's Shockwave start in Warframe?
items.content:
Guide When does Nightwave: Amir's Shockwave start in Warframe? Gotta go fast.

A big change is coming to Warframe, and Amir is taking over Nora Night's Nightwave event. Amir's Shockwave will bring all-new rewards, as well as other content that is sure to add some new build options to your arsenal, if previous Nightwaves are any indicator.

Amir's Shockwave will start on August 12 and is likely to begin around 9 AM PT. You'll be able to jump into the game and start completing your Daily, Weekly, and Elite Challenges to rack up experience and rank up your free Nightwave Battle Pass. Remember, Nightwave content is always 100% in Warframe. No fee, and no premium track.

You can also expect a new enemy, as a fresh form of Eximus unit will be introduced with this series. Also, while not a direct part of the Shockwave event, be sure to check your KIM system for Fabels and Frontiers, a mini-adventure to play with Amir that acts as an ode to tabletop gaming.

items.title: Warframe of Mind: The problem with Warframe’s Dog Days of summer
Prime Resurgence
items.summary: Two iconic forces return to the Origin System! Baruuk Prime and Revenant Prime are now available in Prime Resurgence. Whether you’re a new Tenno beginning your journey or a veteran returning to battle, this rotation offers the opportunity t
items.content:
Two iconic forces return to the Origin System! Baruuk Prime and Revenant Prime are now available in Prime Resurgence. Whether you’re a new Tenno beginning your journey or a veteran returning to battle, this rotation offers the opportunity to expand your Arsenal instantly with Regal Aya.

Meet the Primes

Baruuk Prime A master of restraint, Baruuk Prime walks the line between pacifism and devastating force. Calm the battlefield, disarm your enemies and unleash overwhelming power when pushed to your limit. If you prefer a measured approach that can erupt into unstoppable strength, Baruuk Prime might be the Warframe for you. Revenant Prime An immortal force of Eidolon, Revenant Prime turns the power of his enemies against them. Mesmerize foes, steal their strength and become a chaotic presence on the battlefield. If you prefer to dominate your enemies and make their power your own, Revenant Prime might be the Warframe for you. Prime Warframes Want to learn more about Prime Warframes?

Check out our guide to Prime Warframes video for a helpful breakdown of what Prime Warframes are, different ways you can earn them and how you can purchase Prime items.

items.title: Dog Days 2026
items.summary: Get ready to soak up some summer sun, Tenno! Dog Days returns on August 4 , bringing back Warframe’s annual summer splash with new Rewards, gameplay adjustments and plenty of seaside fun. New to Dog Days? Welcome to the beach, Tenno! Dog Da
items.content:
Get ready to soak up some summer sun, Tenno! Dog Days returns on August 4, bringing back Warframe’s annual summer splash with new Rewards, gameplay adjustments and plenty of seaside fun.

New to Dog Days?

Welcome to the beach, Tenno! Dog Days is a summer celebration where everyone plays on equal footing. Complete Vor’s Prize and unlock Cetus to join the festivities, then dive into the action by taking part in the Main Event Alerts to earn Community Glyphs and accompanying Rewards!

How To Play

From Navigation, select the Dog Days Missions under the Event tab to be transported to a tropical arena that shifts from day to night. The Dog Day’s arena is a water munitions-only zone, which means there are no Mods, Buffs (Invigorations and Archon shards), Companions, or Abilities. Winning a match depends on who can drench the opposing team the most (Tenno vs. Grineer) before the timer runs out. Whether you’re a long-time veteran or a brand-new Tenno, grab your Soaktron and get ready to make a splash!

New Rewards

There’s plenty to look forward to when Dog Days returns, including new Rewards and cosmetics to add to your collection. Earn Nakak Pearls by taking part in the event, then trade them in with Nakak on Cetus for a variety of beachside goodies! Daybreak Domestik Drone: Log in during the event to receive this Inbox Reward. Community Glyphs: Take part in Main Event Alerts to earn Community Glyphs and accompanying Rewards! Daybreak Skins: Bring some extra summer style to your Arsenal with these new customization items. Honoria: Flaunt a new, summer-themed Honoria during Dog Days. Daybreak Domestik Drone: Log in during the event to receive this Inbox Reward. Community Glyphs: Take part in Main Event Alerts to earn Community Glyphs and accompanying Rewards: Alert 1: Community Dog Days Kela De Thaym Glyph + 50K Credits + 25 Pearls Alert 2: Community Dog Days Rusalka Glyph + 50K Credits + 50 Pearls Alert 3: Community Dog Days Erra Glyph + 50K Credits + 75 Pearls Alert 4 (Bonus): Community Dog Days Executioner Garesh Glyph + 50K Credits + (100 Pearls + 2 Pearls per kill) Credits to Community Artist @SpaceWaifuart for creating this years Dog Days Glyphs! Please note: Replaying Mission 4 earns you Nakak Pearls for each enemy you soak to smithereens, and now also for assists. Daybreak Skins: Bring some extra summer style to your Arsenal with these new customization items: Magistar Daybreak Skin Daybreak Dax Syandana Bubonico Daybreak Skin Daybreak Sugatra Kompressa Daybreak Skin Honoria: Flaunt a new, summer-themed Honoria during Dog Days.

Floaty of Fury Alerts & Double Affinity Weekends

Special Floaty of Fury Alerts will appear throughout the event, offering additional ways to earn Rewards and Nakak Pearls. August 6 - 10: Defense (Uranus) - 175 Nakak Pearls + 50K Credits August 13 - 17: Exterminate (Venus) - 175 Nakak Pearls + 50K Credits August 20 - 24: Interception (Jupiter) - 175 Nakak Pearls + 50K Credits August 27 - 31: Survival (Sedna) - 175 Nakak Pearls + 50K Credits September 3 - 7: Sabotage (Pluto) - 175 Nakak Pearls + 50K Credits Additionally, Double Affinity Weekends will be running at the same time as the Alerts to help make the most of your summer. Be sure to keep an eye on the Star Chart and don’t miss your chance to dive into these special Alerts!

Event Changes

Dog Days is making some waves with gameplay adjustments designed to make this year’s summer skirmish even more fun: Floaty of Fury Alerts: These special Alerts will now override your melee loadout with the Noodletron and lock you out of your equipped Primary and Secondary Weapons. To compensate, you’ll also benefit from increased melee speed as you take on the challenge. Soaktron: The Soaktron has received increased Projectile Velocity, letting you soak your opponents from even farther away!

Community Captura Contest

Think you’ve got what it takes to capture the perfect summer moment? Keep an eye out for an upcoming forum post with more details on the Dog Days 2026 Community Captura Contest, including rules, submission details and more. Whether you’re a seasoned Tenno or just getting started, there’s plenty of fun waiting for you when Dog Days returns. See you surfside, Tenno!

items.title: August 2026 Events
items.summary: Grab yourself a cool drink and soak up the sun Origin System-style with everything happening in Warframe this month! We’ve got the return of Dog Days, a new Nightwave signal with Amir’s Shockwave, a miniature narrative adventure in Fables &
items.content:
Grab yourself a cool drink and soak up the sun Origin System-style with everything happening in Warframe this month! We’ve got the return of Dog Days, a new Nightwave signal with Amir’s Shockwave, a miniature narrative adventure in Fables & Frontiers: Running Late, fresh TennoGen creations and so much more! Be sure to look over the sections below for what you can expect throughout August.

Dog Days 2026

When: August 4 You know the old saying: sun’s out, guns out. We’re happy to share that everyone’s favorite seaside slobberknocker that is Dog Days returns this summer! Get ready for our annual beach party rife with continuous Event Alerts, weekly Floaty of Fury Alerts and Affinity Booster Weekends that can net you some sick new (and returning) Rewards like the Daybreak Dax Syandana, Community Dog Days Glyphs and plenty more.

Amir's Shockwave

When: August 12 The Hex hacker is taking up hosting duties with Nightwave Mix: Amir’s Shockwave. Prepare yourself for an absolutely electrifying broadcast, rife with new 1999-themed Rewards like the Globakk Syandana, Kaneshell Atomicycle Regalia, Teisatz Oculus and so much more!

Fables & Frontiers: Running Late

When: August 12 All-new tales await in Fables & Frontiers: Running Late. This small-scale KIM narrative adventure will have none other than Amir guide you through an approximation of the Fables & Frontiers tabletop game from Warframe: 1999 where you can earn new Rewards like Atomicycle Key Sugatra, Fables & Frontiers Glyphs and plenty more!

TennoGen: Fables & Frontiers

When: August 12 An altogether striking series of new community-made Customizations await with TennoGen: Fables & Frontiers. You can pick up fresh fits like the Kullervo Ascophilia Skin, Haemadys Mask, Oraxia Agamva Helmet and more!

New On-lyne Song: Running Late

When: August 12 The boys are once again in sync and there’s no turning back. On-lyne returns with “Running Late” — another certifiable banger by composers Keith Power and Matthew Chalmers that’s sure to be a summertime hit. The track will be available in-game as an unlockable Somachord via Fables & Frontiers: Running Late vendor (Amir). We will have streaming platform details for “Running Late” available in the days to come.

items.title: Summer Sale 2026
items.summary: Expand your Arsenal and boost your battle-readiness with red hot deals from Warframe's latest Summer Sale. Whatever your level of experience – from new Tenno to hardened vets – there's a discounted bundle with your name on it until the sale
items.content:

items.title: Amir’s Shockwave Coming Soon
items.summary: Hearing a hiccup or two in the signal, Tenno? That’s because the infamous Hex hacker is taking over Nightwave with Nightwave Mix: Amir’s Shockwave, which arrives on August 12 ! Past and future collide in this electrifying Nightwave full of
items.content:
Hearing a hiccup or two in the signal, Tenno? That’s because the infamous Hex hacker is taking over Nightwave with Nightwave Mix: Amir’s Shockwave, which arrives on August 12! Past and future collide in this electrifying Nightwave full of all-new Rewards that will undoubtedly add a (shocking) spring to your step.

Rewards Include:

This time around, you can earn the 1999-themed Globakk Syandana, Kaneshell Atomicycle Regalia, Teisatz Oculus and much, much more! Stay tuned for more details on all the rewards up for grabs as we get closer to the event. So don’t swap stations just yet, as we’ll have more information regarding Nightwave Mix: Amir’s Shockwave when it releases on August 12.

Fables & Frontiers: Running Late

Entirely separate from this new series of Nightwave Mix Rewards, there’s also the brand-new six-day KIM mini narrative adventure in the form of Fables & Frontiers: Running Late, releasing on August 12! Allow the mischievous technophile Amir to guide you through this bite-sized take on the Fables & Frontiers tabletop game from the world of Warframe: 1999. To unlock Fables & Frontiers: Running Late, you must complete The Hex Quest’s finale and reach Rank 5 with The Hex Syndicate and a KIM Chemistry of “Close” (Rank 5) with Amir himself. Earn several new Rewards from Fables & Frontiers: Running Late, including an all-new Atomicycle Key Sugatra, Fables & Frontiers Glyphs for each member of The Hex, several returning items from Nora's Mix Vol. 8 and much more! All of these can be redeemed from Amir by ringing the bell in a new area of The Höllvania Central Mall in exchange for Hex Standing. Please Note: Fables & Frontiers: Running Late is a permanent addition to the KIM System that you can access anytime by meeting the correct prerequisites and is not tied to Nightwave Mix: Amir’s Shockwave.

What is Nightwave?

Experiencing this facet of Warframe for the first time? Nightwave is a pirate radio broadcast hosted by Nora Night (or, in this case, Amir of The Hex), focused on the latest stories in the Origin System. Nightwave is also a series of Daily, Weekly and now Acts. All of which offer new and useful (and often entirely unique) Rewards! Nightwave is available via the Base of Operations’ Navigation console, through the Orbiter’s radio scanner (located on the left side of your Orbiter’s bridge), or via the Pause Menu UI. In the Nightwave menu, you’ll see your progress through the current mix, your current Reward Tiers, as well as a rotating set of Daily, Weekly, Elite Weekly and Permanent Weekly Acts. Stick with Nightwave each day and get some fantastic Customizations!

items.title: Destiny 2’s Demise Is ‘Existentially Threatening,’ Says ‘Warframe’ Creative Director
items.summary: Another game in the live-service shooter genre, Warframe, has been running in parallel with Destiny for ages, maintaining perhaps greater consistency over time,
items.content:
Gaming Destiny 2’s Demise Is ‘Existentially Threatening,’ Says ‘Warframe’ Creative Director By Paul Tassi ,

Forbes contributors publish independent expert analyses and insights. News and opinion about video games, television, movies and the internet. Follow Author Jul 13, 2026, 11:11am EDT Jul 13, 2026, 04:46pm EDT --:-- / --:-- This voice experience is generated by AI. Learn more . This voice experience is generated by AI. Learn more . Warframe/Marathon Digital Extremes, Bungie Well, this would happen in any normal season of Destiny 2, but the game is starting its downward slope in terms of players departing. It is not an abrupt drop-off, which is great to see, and it’s still performing well a month after its final update, Monument of Triumph. But there’s the rub, the final update. Nothing else is coming here for the formerly live game.

Another game in the live-service shooter genre, Warframe , has been running in parallel with Destiny for ages, maintaining perhaps greater consistency over time, and still surviving, even thriving to this day. But rather than celebrate a “win” over the departed Destiny , it’s making its higher-ups sad and nervous. Some new comments come from Warframe Creative Director Rebb Ford in an interview with GamesRadar during the recent TennoCon:

"It's horrible news, because it shows that even if you care so much, the business side of this industry always gets the last remark.”

"Those are the types of stories and experiences that, when you're in a position where you have your own game, your own IP, and you work as hard as you do on it... That's not the first time it's happened, and it'll happen again, where the business aspect of the video game economy makes the decision for you, and it is existentially threatening at every level, because the idea that we aren't in charge of our own goodbye is something I wake up thinking about every single day."

Destiny 2 Bungie In the case of Destiny , there were years-long plans for the second game, and if it was up to the devs at Bungie, most would eagerly have hopped on board the production of a Destiny 3. But cost, cost, cost killed the game, partly due to poor management decisions that exacerbated those costs, and partly due to the baseline of a game that requires such an enormous investment to maintain endless live content. As I’ve previously reported, there have only been a few times in its history that Destiny 2 has been profitable.

Right until the end, you could feel the passion of the Destiny devs with an exceptional final update that put the game in its best state in years…right before there was no more new content to play. The player surge was higher than both of the last two expansions despite almost nothing new to play, and again, it maintains good numbers after a month. But those will continue falling, which cannot be helped.

Ford may be right to be nervous about the state of the industry and working on a very similar game. Warframe’s Digital Extremes does not have to answer to Sony, however, and costs are not at the same level as Destiny . But they’ve figured out a sustainable groove, and there’s no sign of the game ending any time remotely soon.

Follow me on Twitter , YouTube , and Instagram .

Pick up my sci-fi novels the Herokiller series and The Earthborn Trilogy .

items.title: TennoCon 2026
items.summary: That's a wrap on TennoCon 2026! Thank you to everyone for celebrating the future of Warframe with us, whether you joined in-person or watched this year's incredible reveals from home. We couldn't do it without you. If you missed them live (
items.content:
That's a wrap on TennoCon 2026! Thank you to everyone for celebrating the future of Warframe with us, whether you joined in-person or watched this year's incredible reveals from home. We couldn't do it without you. If you missed them live (or simply want to re-watch), you can find the and full TennoLive VODs on our YouTube channel! For a closer, bonus look at the Art & Animation of Warframe, click here.

AWAKEN TO A NEW SYSTEM

Warframe: Tau | Official Trailer

The path to Tau will soon open, taking you beyond the boundaries of the Origin System for the very first time. Get ready to risk it all in a brand new region of space orbiting a binary star and teeming with new experiences.

Get ready to risk it all. Warframe: Tau arrives later this year.

TennoCon 2026 Gameplay Demo

During your first foray into the lost paradise that is the Tau System, you'll sneak into the heart of a Sentient city ruined by criminality and corruption. But this is only the beginning, and marks a new journey for Warframe with much more of Tau to come, including another as-yet-to-be-revealed location launching with the full update later in 2026. Stay tuned for more details soon.

TennoLive 2026 Relay

Those who entered this year's in-game TennoLive Relay bore witness to a wild new addition to the Tenno fleet: their very own Vessel. You can still jump in and experience it for yourself until the Relay closes on July 13 at 10 a.m. ET. Think you missed out? Think again! Starting July 13, any Tenno who has completed Vor's Prize will be able to see and personalize their Vessel from ANY Dry Dock on the Star Chart. Keep watch for Arturos and Zioa, who will answer their calling later this year…

Enter a Sentient Metropolis

Your journey in this new Star Chart begins in the Bloom-soaked decay of Fornax, a lawless ring city densely populated with all manner of degenerates and drenched in unending waves of madness-inducing black rain. Between the addicts in its slums and the thugs working its docks, reaching the casino at the heart of this urban hellscape requires quick wits and an even quicker trigger finger.

Scour the Streets with Brysko

A noir-inspired Warframe working with Albrecht Entrati to infiltrate the Sentient criminal underworld, Brysko chases down leads with a relentlessness matched only by his cynicism. Although silent to the world, his inner monologue belies an honorable ethos… at least until the occasion calls for his Corecracker or Rain & Shine — an Exalted Pistol and a pair of brutal Fist weapons, respectively.

Tangle with the Fornax Drowners

The enforcers, hired hands and knucklebusters standing in your way comprise a new faction of Sentient enemies who have evolved far and away from the familiar foes of the Origin System. Though you're more than equipped to take them out, don't get too cocky, especially when the black rain begins to fall…

Defy the Hunra

Control over the many rackets in Fornax rests with the Hunra, a brutal kingpin at the center of the Sentient underbelly who enthusiastically dispenses violence, fear and Bloom to maintain his seat at the head of the table. To reach him, you'll need to overcome his legions of loyalists, any of whom would happily dispatch you to curry favor with the Boss, who seems as untouchable as he is implacable.

Try your hand at Portau

Fortune rarely smiles in Fornax, but when it does, the gamblers hunched at the casino's Portau tables earn the closest thing here to an honest living. Warframe's first original card game is built on unique suits of Blooms, Cores, Moons and Suns, and offers some welcome excitement amidst the hustle and heartbreak of Tau. Why not test your luck and play a few hands for yourself?

New Music: "View From The Top"

Doomy, gloomy, yet undeniably stylish, our Gameplay Demo's seductive allure was all the more potent thanks to the sultry sounds of a particular musical number sung by Sentient crooner Larynde. If you haven't heard it yet (or just want an immediate re-listen), the visualizer for "View From The Top" is also now available on the Official Warframe YouTube Channel.

COMING THIS FALL

Iceblade of Narin

Our Fall 2026 update has been named! Before you venture beyond the Origin System to Tau, we will first introduce the 66th Warframe, two new Deluxe Collections, a highly-anticipated Rework, the next Prime Access release and more. Join us for our next Devstream on September 4 to learn more.

Banshee Deluxe and Rework

Darkness comes for the scream queen with her first Deluxe Collection since 2016: a suite of Customizations evoking nightmares and the nocturnal, designed by community artist Mischka. Banshee mains can also look forward to an upcoming Rework that will improve her sound-based Abilities and overall playability.

Qorvex Deluxe

We're working hard to spruce up Albrecht Entrati's original designs for his indomitable, concrete-based Warframe, Qorvex. With a new Skin and Customizations inspired by gargoyles and gothic architecture, this radioactive behemoth has never looked better.

Citrine Prime Access

The luminously lustrous Citrine will receive a Prime polishing when she enters Prime Access later this year, crystalizing her greatness with pristine, golden glam. She'll release alongside upgraded Prime Weapons, Accessories and more, which we'll reveal in greater detail soon, so stay tuned.

SOULFRAME

Warsongs: A Soulframe Fable

A splinter in the heart, sings in the dream.

Meet Bayor, an Envoy like yourself but sworn to Synod and the Ode. Venture back to memories of your childhood with Doyen. Ride into the fray on wolf-back as you confront the threat in the present. Embrace the corruption of the Vadagar as a new path to progression in Soulframe.

Full Soulframe Recap

Read the complete event recap for more details on the unveiling of a new Pact, the upcoming addition of fishing, long-awaited mounts and the Mendicant Reinbreaker which awaits your challenge in-game right now. Or hear the details from the developers themselves with the TennoCon 2026 Soulframe Devstream, available here.

EVENTS

Amir's Shockwave

Get ready for a shakeup like you've never heard before! This August, Amir of the Hex will be cutting through the airwaves (and across space and time) to bring you a double-dose of 1999-themed content. Not only will he be hosting his own remixed edition of Nightwave replete with never-before-seen Rewards, but he'll also be joining his Protoframe teammates for a unique KIM narrative adventure, Fables & Frontiers: Running Late.

TennoVIP 2026 Tour

We're set to connect with more Tenno than ever thanks to a host of new TennoVIP events around the world. With Warframe developers set to visit South Korea, China, London and Glasgow, this could be your chance to meet up for the ultimate IRL experience. Ticket registration for future stops will go live at a later date, so keep an eye on our official social channels.

Dog Days 2026

What's summer without a trip to the beach? Warframe's hottest seasonal event returns on August 4 with sizzling Rewards including four new Glyphs designed by community artist SpaceWaifu.

Warframe x Fortnite

Warframe's original swordsman brings his mastery of the blade to the world of Fortnite! For the first time, Tenno can squad up, drop into the Island, and outrun the storm as the legendary Warframe with a brand-new Excalibur Outfit.

PACKS & MERCH

Mesa Heirloom Collection

Our latest hallowed Heirloom Collection is now available! The legendary gunslinger, Mesa, has new Customizations to keep your spurs jingling, including her signature brimmed Signa and travel-worn Duster attachments featuring additional toggles so you can always adjust her look to your liking. https://store.steampowered.com/app/4735410/Warframe_Mesa_Heirloom_Collection/

TennoCon 2026 Merch

Warframe's biggest day of the year may be over, but you can still keep the party going with the TennoCon 2026 Merch Pack. Show the world you were there when Warframe moved beyond the Origin System to Tau with this year's exclusive IRL Customizations.

TennoCon 2026 Giveaways

There's still time to enter our celebratory giveaways and secure your chance to win some truly stellar prizes — including gaming gear from HyperX, the Stalker jersey from Champion, Platinum from yours truly, and a powerful, customized PC from OMEN. Good luck, Tenno! Enter Now!

Community

Cosplay Contest

Our annual Cosplay Contest returned to the Canada Life Place, with a fresh roster of designs from around the Origin System. Contenders were judged on performance and craftsmanship by special guest judges, to the resounding cheers of their fellow Tenno.

Art Showcase

The Origin System’s finest artists delivered once again! Contest finalists saw their work displayed for all to behold at TennoCon — a testament to the passion and creativity of Tenno from all over the world.

Dojo Showcase

Presenting your winners of the #TennoCon 2026 Dojo Showcase! Participating decorators were invited to submit their best in-game builds from over the past two years. With more than 75 submissions from three different Warframe builds, narrowing down the winners was no easy feat.

SPECIAL THANKS

Sistema Toronto

Sistema Toronto is a free after-school music and social development program for children living in underserved communities with the end goal of transformative social action. Your donations allow Sistema Toronto students to play real instruments, receive instruction with professional musicians, eat a healthy snack every day, and benefit from a community of support.

London Cares

London Cares Homeless Response Services delivers frontline support to chronic homelessness through street outreach, supportive housing, and housing stability services. By integrating housing with health, income, and community supports, they help people achieve lasting stability while strengthening the systems that serve them

Hoku Props

Award winning propmakers Hoku Props returned to TennoCon with another iconic cosplay: Father Lyon Allard, the Harrow Protoframe! Meticulously crafted with an astounding attention to detail, this was one of their most faithful designs yet — an impressive tribute to an iconic character from last year's The Old Peace (and his many devoted fans).

arborealkey

France-based costume and prop creator arborealkey crafted a most captivating cosplay for Sister Marie Leroux, and her ethereal presence was one of the highlights of the showfloor here in London, Ontario.

Blink

Blink certainly stepped up to the challenge with their latest project: Old War veteran and infamous heartthrob, Roathe. With a loving eye and the incredible attention to detail they're known for, they brought this fearsome figure to life as faithfully as we could have fathomed.

Plexi Cosplay

Plexi Cosplay brought to life the Brewer of Hues, Verminia! Delighting Soulframe fans on the convention floor with astute aura assessments, her presence was as lively as her designs are delightful.

items.title: Warframe: Tau Gameplay Demo
items.summary: This year's TennoLive mainstage presentation took us beyond the limits of the Origin System to Tau, a place that until now has only existed in our collective dreams (and of course, memories via The Old Peace). Community Director Megan Evere
items.content: This year's TennoLive mainstage presentation took us beyond the limits of the Origin System to Tau, a place that until now has only existed in our collective dreams (and of course, memories via The Old Peace). Community Director Megan Everett guided Tenno through their first foray into Warframe's first ENTIRELY NEW star system, which will include fresh worlds to explore as ongoing cinematic narrative flourishes in a massive new region beyond anything you've ever known. Coming to all platforms later this year, our next major update will begin to answer the question: "What has become of Tau?" While the future will ultimately offer a wider look at this vast binary star system, the path to get there begins in Fornax — a sprawling Sentient metropolis consisting of Slums, Docks, and seedy gambling dens. The extent of Fornax's corruption is apparent in both the addicts and criminals who populate it, as well as the unending black rain that pours down on them during frequent storms… with horrifying results. Albrecht Entrati is already here, having enlisted the help of a new, noir-inspired Warframe named Brysko to help him infiltrate the Sentient underworld and reach the Hunra. This fearsome kingpin maintains control of Fornax's many rackets through violence, intimidation and fear, and it will be up to you to reach him in time to avert the breakout of a cataclysmic new conflict. With the return of old friends, old foes and old wounds gone-but-not-forgotten, Tau will confront you with horrifying consequences from your past, and an incredibly bright new canvas for the evolving future of Warframe. Learn more by visiting our official webpage for Warframe: Tau here and be sure to watch our upcoming Devstreams at twitch.tv/warframe for more details on the journey that lies ahead.
